title: "I'm sorry to hear that”: Finding New Biases in Language Models with a Holistic Descriptor Dataset
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset, HOLISTICBIAS, which explicitly includes 'Religion' as one of its 13 demographic axes for benchmarking bias in language models. It compiles and uses a list of nearly 40 religious and spiritual identifiers in its test prompts, making the evaluation of model responses to religious terms a core component of its methodology.
